notificationBody.Fajr: Begin your day with prayer and Allah's blessings.
notificationBody.Dhuhr: Pause your day and return to Allah in prayer.
notificationBody.Asr: Keep your heart connected to Allah with the Asr prayer.
notificationBody.Maghrib: End your day with gratitude and the Maghrib prayer.
notificationBody.Isha: Close your day with Isha and peaceful remembrance.
